# Variable `TEST_EXPORT_DIR`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

The location the OpenEmbedded build system uses to export tests when the TEST_EXPORT_ONLY variable is set to “1”.

The TEST_EXPORT_DIR variable defaults to `"${TMPDIR}/testimage/${PN}"`.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-TEST_EXPORT_DIR)
